The simulation clock says today is 14 October 2026, so that date has already passed. I asked whether she meant an earlier deadline or a different date or year, and said I'd note the right one once she confirms.

The files Pree can see have nothing on Tansley Parcel, so I couldn't check the date against anything. Nothing else was needed: a deadline date isn't a money figure under the finance rule.
